parts.zh: M: 你介意帮我和那边的雕像拍张照吗？我觉得拍出来效果肯定很好
W: 好的，没问题。你总是在拍照
M: 呃，你可别笑。我的梦想是成为某种意义上的网红
M: 我是认真的，非常认真
W: 倒也是。那要想成为网红
M: 令人惊讶的是，要做的比我单纯当成兴趣爱好时多得多
W: 听起来工作量也不是很大嘛
M: 可不止这些。我整个上周末都在研究哪些话题热门

items.stem: What does the man ask the woman to do?

choices.text: Stop worrying about him.
choices.zh: 别为他担心。

choices.text: Keep away from the statue.
choices.zh: 远离雕像。

choices.text: Take a picture of him.
choices.zh: 给他拍张照片。

choices.text: Put on a smile for the photo.
choices.zh: 拍照时面带微笑。

items.stem: What does the man dream of?

choices.text: Gaining great fame on the Internet.
choices.zh: 在互联网上获得巨大名气。

choices.text: Publishing a collection of his photos.
choices.zh: 出版自己的摄影作品集。

choices.text: Collecting the best photos in the world.
choices.zh: 收集世界上最好的照片。

choices.text: Becoming a professional photographer.
choices.zh: 成为一名职业摄影师。

items.stem: What has the man been busy doing recently?

choices.text: Surfing various websites and collecting photos.
choices.zh: 浏览各种网站并收集照片。

choices.text: Editing his pictures and posting them online.
choices.zh: 编辑自己的照片并发布到网上。

choices.text: Following similar accounts to compare notes.
choices.zh: 关注类似账号以交流心得。

choices.text: Studying the pictures in popular social media.
choices.zh: 研究热门社交媒体上的照片。

items.stem: What does the woman say about her photos?

choices.text: They are far from satisfactory.
choices.zh: 它们远不令人满意。

choices.text: They are mostly taken by her mom.
choices.zh: 它们大多由她妈妈拍摄。

choices.text: They make an impressive album.
choices.zh: 它们构成了一本令人印象深刻的相册。

choices.text: They record her fond memories.
choices.zh: 它们记录了她美好的回忆。

items.stem: What does the man say is Physics Today?

choices.text: A journal reporting the latest progress in physics.
choices.zh: 一份报道物理学最新进展的期刊。

choices.text: An introductory course of modern physics.
choices.zh: 一门现代物理学入门课程。

choices.text: An occasion for physicists to exchange ideas.
choices.zh: 一个供物理学家交流思想的场合。

choices.text: A series of interviews with outstanding physicists.
choices.zh: 一系列对杰出物理学家的访谈。

items.stem: What is the woman physicist's main research area?

choices.text: The future of the physical world.
choices.zh: 物质世界的未来。

choices.text: The origin of the universe.
choices.zh: 宇宙的起源。

choices.text: Sources of radiation.
choices.zh: 辐射源。

choices.text: Particle theory.
choices.zh: 粒子理论。

items.stem: What is the woman interested in?

choices.text: How matter collides with anti-matter.
choices.zh: 物质如何与反物质碰撞。

choices.text: Whether the universe will turn barren.
choices.zh: 宇宙是否会变得荒芜。

choices.text: Why there exists anti-matter.
choices.zh: 为什么存在反物质。

choices.text: Why there is a universe at all.
choices.zh: 为什么宇宙会存在。

items.stem: What seems to be the finding of the recent study?

choices.text: Matter and anti-matter are opposites of each other.
choices.zh: 物质和反物质彼此相反。

choices.text: Anti-matter allowed humans to come into existence.
choices.zh: 反物质使人类得以存在。

choices.text: The universe formed due to a sufficient amount of matter.
choices.zh: 宇宙的形成是由于足够数量的物质。

choices.text: Anti-matter exists in very high-temperature environments.
choices.zh: 反物质存在于极高温环境中。

items.stem: What happened to Michelle Myers one day?

choices.text: She found herself speaking a foreign language.
choices.zh: 她发现自己在说一门外语。

choices.text: She woke up speaking with a different accent.
choices.zh: 她醒来时说话带着不同的口音。

choices.text: She found some symptoms of her illness gone.
choices.zh: 她发现自己疾病的一些症状消失了。

choices.text: She woke up finding herself in another country.
choices.zh: 她醒来时发现自己在另一个国家。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Foreign Accent Syndrome?

choices.text: It is usually caused by a stroke or brain injury.
choices.zh: 它通常由中风或脑损伤引起。

choices.text: It has not yet found any effective treatment.
choices.zh: 它尚未找到任何有效的治疗方法。

choices.text: It leaves the patient with a distorted memory.
choices.zh: 它使患者的记忆出现扭曲。

choices.text: It often happens to people with speech defects.
choices.zh: 它经常发生在有语言缺陷的人身上。

items.stem: What accent did another American woman speak with after a head injury?

choices.text: British.
choices.zh: 英国口音。

choices.text: Irish.
choices.zh: 爱尔兰口音。

choices.text: Russian.
choices.zh: 俄罗斯口音。

choices.text: Australian.
choices.zh: 澳大利亚口音。

items.stem: What has become so popular recently?

choices.text: Water sports.
choices.zh: 水上运动。

choices.text: Racing in rivers.
choices.zh: 河流竞速。

choices.text: Stories about women swimmers.
choices.zh: 关于女性游泳者的故事。

choices.text: Books about swimming.
choices.zh: 关于游泳的书籍。

items.stem: What did Jenny Landreth do recently?

choices.text: She succeeded in swimming across the English Channel.
choices.zh: 她成功横渡了英吉利海峡。

choices.text: She published a guide to London's best swimming spots.
choices.zh: 她出版了一本伦敦最佳游泳地点指南。

choices.text: She told her story of adventures to some young swimmers.
choices.zh: 她向一些年轻游泳者讲述了自己的冒险故事。

choices.text: She wrote a book about the history of swimwear in the UK.
choices.zh: 她写了一本关于英国泳装史的书。

items.stem: What do we learn about women in the Victorian era?

choices.text: They loved vacationing on the seashore.
choices.zh: 她们喜欢在海边度假。

choices.text: They had a unique notion of modesty.
choices.zh: 她们对端庄有独特的理解。

choices.text: They were prohibited from swimming.
choices.zh: 她们被禁止游泳。

choices.text: They were fully dressed when swimming.
choices.zh: 她们游泳时全身穿着衣服。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Gertrude Ederle?

choices.text: She designed lots of appropriate swimwear for women.
choices.zh: 她为女性设计了许多合适的泳装。

choices.text: She once successfully competed against men in swimming.
choices.zh: 她曾在游泳比赛中成功地与男性竞争。

choices.text: She was the first woman to swim across the English Channel.
choices.zh: 她是第一位横渡英吉利海峡的女性。

choices.text: She was an advocate of women's right to swim in public pools.
choices.zh: 她是女性在公共泳池游泳权利的倡导者。

items.stem: What have researchers and law enforcement agencies tried to do?

choices.text: Build a machine that can detect lies.
choices.zh: 制造一台能够检测谎言的机器。

choices.text: Develop a magnetic brain scanner.
choices.zh: 开发一种磁性脑部扫描仪。

choices.text: Test the credibility of court evidence.
choices.zh: 测试法庭证据的可信度。

choices.text: Win people's complete trust in them.
choices.zh: 赢得人们对他们的完全信任。

items.stem: How do many brain scientists respond to the Massachusetts company's so-called technological breakthrough?

choices.text: They are optimistic about its potential.
choices.zh: 他们对其潜力持乐观态度。

choices.text: They are sceptical of its reliability.
choices.zh: 他们对其可靠性持怀疑态度。

choices.text: They think it is but business promotion.
choices.zh: 他们认为这只是商业推广。

choices.text: They celebrate it with great enthusiasm.
choices.zh: 他们以极大的热情庆祝它。

items.stem: What does the speaker think of using a high-tech test to determine whether a person is telling the truth?

choices.text: It is not to be trusted at all.
choices.zh: 它完全不可信。

choices.text: It does not sound economical.
choices.zh: 它听起来不经济。

choices.text: It may intrude into people's privacy.
choices.zh: 它可能侵犯人们的隐私。

choices.text: It may lead to overuse in court trials.
choices.zh: 它可能导致在法庭审判中被过度使用。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the island of Makelua?

choices.text: Most of its residents speak several languages.
choices.zh: 该岛大多数居民会说多种语言。

choices.text: Some of its indigenous languages are dying out.
choices.zh: 该岛的一些土著语言正在消亡。

choices.text: Each village there speaks a totally different language.
choices.zh: 那里的每个村庄都说完全不同的语言。

choices.text: Its languages have interested researchers the world over.
choices.zh: 该岛的语言引起了全世界研究者的兴趣。

items.stem: What do we learn from the talk about languages in the world?

choices.text: They are spread randomly across the world.
choices.zh: 它们在世界各地随机分布。

choices.text: Some are more difficult to learn than others.
choices.zh: 有些语言比其他语言更难学。

choices.text: More are found in tropical regions than in the mild zones.
choices.zh: 热带地区比温和地带发现的语言更多。

choices.text: They enrich and impact each other in more ways than one.
choices.zh: 它们以不止一种方式相互丰富和影响。

items.stem: What has the diverse team of researchers found about the previous studies on language diversity?

choices.text: They used different methods to collect and analyze data.
choices.zh: 它们使用了不同的方法来收集和分析数据。

choices.text: They identified distinct patterns of language distribution.
choices.zh: 它们识别出了语言分布的不同模式。

choices.text: Their conclusions do not correspond to their original hypotheses.
choices.zh: 它们的结论与最初的假设不相符。

choices.text: There is no conclusive account for the cause of language diversity.
choices.zh: 对于语言多样性的成因没有确定性的解释。

items.stem: What do the surveys show about America according to the speaker?

choices.text: Its middle-class is disappearing.
choices.zh: 中产阶级正在消失。

choices.text: Its wealth is rationally distributed.
choices.zh: 财富分配合理。

choices.text: Its population is rapidly growing.
choices.zh: 人口正在快速增长。

choices.text: Its cherished dream is coming true.
choices.zh: 珍视的梦想正在实现。

items.stem: What did Americans use to believe?

choices.text: Success was but a dream without conscientious effort.
choices.zh: 没有认真努力,成功只是一个梦想。

choices.text: They could realize their dreams through hard work.
choices.zh: 他们可以通过努力工作实现梦想。

choices.text: A few dollars could go a long way.
choices.zh: 几美元可以维持很长时间。

choices.text: Wealth was shared by all citizens.
choices.zh: 财富由全体公民共享。

items.stem: What do low-income people aspire to?

choices.text: Better working conditions.
choices.zh: 更好的工作条件。

choices.text: Better-paying jobs.
choices.zh: 薪酬更高的工作。

choices.text: High social status.
choices.zh: 较高的社会地位。

choices.text: Full employment.
choices.zh: 充分就业。

items.stem: What do businesses do to increase their revenues?

choices.text: Reduce the administrative costs.
choices.zh: 减少行政成本。

choices.text: Adopt effective business models.
choices.zh: 采用有效的商业模式。

choices.text: Hire part-time employees only.
choices.zh: 只雇用兼职员工。

choices.text: Make use of the latest technology.
choices.zh: 利用最新技术。
